Tests that Storage.getItem() and Storage.key() are side-effect-free.
Expression `localStorage.getItem('k')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `localStorage.key(0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `sessionStorage.getItem('sk')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `sessionStorage.key(0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `localStorage.setItem('k', 'v2')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `localStorage.removeItem('k')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `localStorage.clear()`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `sessionStorage.setItem('sk', 'sv2')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `localStorage.getItem({ toString() { window.pwned = 1; return 'k'; } })`
has side effect: true, expected: true
